  A new place, Carnatic has popped up on Church Street. Lovely decor with Indian traditional paintings and a soothing music in the background sets the theme. They have an interesting menu of all the South Indian delicacies.

What I went for was the biryani festival which is on going. 8 different kinds of biryani across various South Indian states from the ever popular hyd biryani to the Mandya pullao to the thalapakatti style from Tamil Nadu.

We were welcomed with a musk melon panakkam and refreshing buttermilk. The starters saw a fiery Andhra chilli chicken with raw heat from green chillies. The favourites among them biryanis was the mandya pullao and thalapakatti. Brilliant.!

Ending with a coconut mousse and obattu. Absolute fun !!

Biryani available for rs. 149 till the duration of the festival (31 Jan)

5. Spicy Habanero Corn and Chicken Pizza - it was okay.

[('Rated 3.0', "RATED
  Been to Atty's three times now. 1 hit and 2 misses. About the hit: Chocolate Ganache - can't recommend this enough, it was delish. Pop it in the microwave for about 15 secs and you have yourself a warm, gooey A1 dessert. 1/2 a kilo gone in a wink!

About the misses: A strawberry pastry. Ordered a kilo of it for a birthday party at home and everyone who ate couldn't finish it. It was sour, and frankly a few of us were concerned if it was even fresh. Super disappointed about the quality of this after having sucha winner as Chocolate Ganache.

Chocolate Truffle cake was another let down. I've had a fair share of Chocolate Truffle cakes from Sweet Chariot - which is kinda my benchmark for truffles in general. I guess the chocolate wasn't rich enough because it lacked the expected depth of chocolate.

  Kuch meetha ho jaye!!

A friend presented me with a gift of goodies by Atty's which was beautifully wrapped with some amazing pastries ,biscotti,garlic bread and brownies .

My personal favourites was

1) Biscotti which had a good texture and the good amount of crispness ,the biscotti were all stuffed with Almonds,cashews and pistachios .I am going back again definitely to buy it .

Overall experience : Atty's bakery definitely a worth trying place with so much more to explore and enjoy.

So next time you need to get a Birthday cake you know where to go.

  I received a basket full of sweet goodies from Atty's (a venture of The EMPIRE hotels) to taste and review.
So the rating and review is purely based on what I got to try!

Pastries: Butterscotch, chocolate, caramel and a couple of others. I loved their caramel pastry!

Ginger almond cookies: The taste of ginger is prominent and the ones who love ginger tea, would love to dip these in a nice hot tea and enjoy. Otherwise, eat them on their own and you will taste the crunchy almond bits and love them.

Plum came: A nice cake it was to have as a snack.

Chocolate and caramel brownie: Again, loved their gooey brownie with walnuts..Caramel one was nice too.

Focaccia bread was pretty good and overall I was a happy person munching on these and sharing with the family.
There are lot more stuffs on offer when I look at their menu. I would love trying more of those..go, do try!

  Went here for a lunch, but they hardly had any option available from their vast menu. Italian was closed, Chinese was limited, even beverages were unavailable.
We ended up ordering Schezwan noodles, fried rice, onion rings, garlic bread, Gobi manchurian (since vegetable manchurian was unavailable), paneer gravy, honey chilli potato and a manchow soup.
Noodles was probably the best thing among all, with fries rice being just ok, onion rings too oily and garlic bread had the garlic flavor only because of the garlic shavings on top. The paneer hardly had any taste and honey chilli potato was not crispy enough. The manchow soup was plain without any fried noodles (they again were unavailable).
They also take a very long time to serve the food and the quantity is also less for the price charged.'), ('Rated 1.0', 'RATED

  There are many outlets that serve hot and relatively cheap Ambur biriyani all over Bangalore but I am told this is authentic. I like the taste and the way they serve it in banana leaves with adequate Raita and gravy . However this is the juciest Biriyani I have ever had'), ('Rated 3.0', 'RATED
  Personally I am a not a fan of Ambur Biryani since I feel that any Biryani made with rice other than Basmati does not qualifies to be one.Well I am sure many of would debate on this.

Though I am not sure but I am reviewing this place assuming that this is one of the bangalore outlets of the famous briyani hotel in Ambur called "Ambur Star Briyani". 
Please feel free to correct me if I erred here.

This place , situated bang opposite the Wipro Corporate Office serves a limited menu that includes chicken biryani , Khuskha ( also commonly called Biryani rice) , kebabs and other starters. Like of most of these places , the dishes are moderately priced and thus become a favourite lunch / dinner destination for those seeking a decent meal at great prices.

If you love ambur Biryani and live in and around sarjapur main road, do try a parcel from their offerings.

thefoodietales.com'), ('Rated 3.0', "RATED
  Went to this place for lunch. This place is opposite to the wipro office, so during weekdays it's jam packed with hungry corporate employees.

There is no ambience because it's not restaurant it's a biriani outlet, but 10 persons can sit and have food.

Coming to food they sell biriani but to be honest it's not biriani it's tomato rice, but the taste is good. The biriani is oily too. They sell a dish named kawab but it's a chicken 65 which tasted good.

It is very pocket friendly the biriani (tomato rice) costs 70rs and the chicken 65 costs 40rs per 100gm. You can choose if you want chicken in your biriani or not based on that the price will reduce.

Overall it's a decent to place to fill"), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  It's a very small Biriyani place just opposite to Wipro gate. I won't talk and ambience as there is none. It's kinda of a Biriyani dhaba.
There are only 3 items on the menu. Check Biriyani, Khuska, Chickens Kababs(Basically Deep Fried Chicken).
The place is very small but clean. You might have to stand and eat during lunch time.

But the Biriyani is awesome. It's a bit oily but the taste is very good. The biriyani Masala is pretty awesome too. One plate biriyani (Rice + 2 piece chicken) costs Rs 70.

If you stay close to Wipro Sarjapur Road, get your bike and get the Biriyani parcel for family and friends. Must Try place.")]

  Chai Kraft got my attention when they had something called Purple Tea. A little digging told me that Purple Tea is a tea brewed from the Butterfly Pea flower which gives the purple colour. As a little hangout spot for tea or coffee or snack or maggi, I chose to go here with my close friend for their Purple tea.

On this menu, they have a Purple Classic Tea, Purple Masala Tea, Purple Virgin Mojito, Purple Iced Tea and Blue Brew Tea. Our choice was Purple Classic Tea and Purple Virgin Mojito.

The tea arrives first. A clear brew of Purple coloured tea with a dash of ginger and lime, it tastes like a lemon ginger tea with an added benefit of the butterfly pea brew.

The Purple Virgin Mojito looks like a magical concoction with a strong brew of the purple flower, soda, lime and ice. A cool drink for the hot summer. As a person with weird taste, I liked the mojito.

  Ambience- 5/5
Location- 5/5
Food- 5/5
Service- 5/5
Staff- 5/5

Built like a fraternity house with different spaces and contrasting moods.
The concept of each space unique personality is fabulous and is the distinguishing factor.
Ground floor- cobbled stone garden
1st floor- private party room
2nd floor- mimansa mood
Terrace- terrace garden.

Menu is also as diverse as the spaces, and serves a variety of cuisine's. We ordered-
*Tomato and mozzarella bruschetta- perfect appetizer to start with.
*Eat your vegies platter- beetroot galouti( exceptionally soft and delicious), paneer tikkq( bit spicy), tandoori soya chaap (protein source), malai broccoli.
*Tenderloin steak- Cooked to medium rare, was tender & juicy inside and well-gazed outside. Mashed potato along with the gravy was complementing it perfectly.(best till date)

  Have been to this place on a Sunday,what made me try this place was the name #Foxtrot , they had some event going on upstairs but we preferred a good dining experience after a heavy Saturday night, and I must say their food got it all,coudnt click any pictures but tried their chilli chicken , pork ribs and my order was Habibi as I was craving to have something whiteish, and I coudnt find pasta , having no regret about it was very satisfied with the quality, presentation and the taste was just wow!! Would like to try other dishes as well when I visit next as of now keep the good food going on!! Cheerz!'), ('Rated 3.0', 'RATED
  Foxtrot is unique place offering a great ambience and cocktails.
The interior of the place is artistically done with a lot of thought and effort going towards it.

The food is average and fails on the flavour part. The portion of each dish is also quite small vs the price you pay.

The presentation of the food is done in style. Plating of each dish is just perfect. The service is good and the staff is courteous.

Best place to catch up with friends over some drinks. Ordering minimum food would be the best option here.
A good option to throw parties as they have separate sections for the same.

Foxtrot can be easily missed among all the competitive plaves in Koramangala but it is a worth a visit.

Cheers!'), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  Located at an quaint place which can be easily mistaken for a bunglow in Koramangala but the vibes and decor of the place is very laid back yet chic with artistery elements all over.

  A good place to have a burger. Bangalore does not have as many good burger joints as are in Delhi. This is a good start. 

The burgers are really juicy, not like very dry burgers as are offered in McDonald's. 

Overall experience on offer is very good. The ambiance is good. Total value for money.

One suggestion - burger can be even bigger. There could be two types of offerings - small and larger"), ('Rated 5.0', "RATED
  Newest place in the block, this restuarant has the potential to be a serious challenge to the thickshake factory and burger King.
I had ordered a nutella thickshake, a cheesy jalapeno french fries and a veg burger the name of which I can't remember but it was second on the menu under veg burgers. All the items were delicious and the shake had perfect thickness.
The staff are polite and this place has good number of games to while away time while food is prepared.
The pricing of food items does not pinch one's pocket.")]

I ordered a daily meal for 350 rs exclusive. Taxes. A miso soup was served which I loved with plenty seaweed and tofu and it tasted real wonderful.
Mains was a bowl of sticky rice, ginger fried pork with fried onions, a side of sesame spinach, some two pieces eggfry roll and a small heap of white radish. I cannot say anything about authenticity but the food was absolutely delicious and fresh plus nicely presented. To me it looked like Japanese home style. Not fatty, not oily, not fried.

My friend ordered a one bowl dish (katsu don) and got a huge bowl of food.

Go: for a worth its money lunch in a very soothing environment

Don't: if you expect sushi. They do not serve that.

  Cafe Cerrise - cafe in a nursery is a very interesting concept who likes outdoor cafes and greenery. I was mesmerized by the variety of colorful plants in the nursery and I wished I could take some home. I ordered fish grill with salsa which was pretty good. Fish was fresh and the sauce was perfect for my taste buds. I ordered that day's special - Mango juice which had tinge of chilly sauce.   Situated in the food court in Vega City Mall, this can be your new South African inspired chicken shop. They tend to give you the spiciest flame grilled out there in the city. Minimal seating and an open kitchen make it an interesting setup for sure.

*Food*
Not many options were available in beverages other than soft drinks. A lot of options in chicken available, the recommended are :

Boneless Chicken Breast
Chicken Espatada
Pulled Chicken Burger

The main issue I find is that even the spiciest sauces don't tend to reach for water ( courtesy Indians spice power). It is a different try for sure.

  Visited the Galito's outlet in Vegacity mall. Galito's proclaims to bring "BOLD AFRICAN FLAVOUR" to our city. Those who've visited Nando's can instantly relate to this place.

The food, the menu, the decor - they all reminded me of Nando's. I will however say that the service here is much better. Galito's' famed flame grilled chicken is "the bee's knees". The peri-peri sauce comes in 5 variants - Mild, Garlic, Hot, Lemon & Herb and Premium Reserve.

The grilled chicken breast in the peri-peri chicken burger could've been tenderized better. The chicken and veggie rice though was flavourful and wholesome.

The fiery pineapple mocktail was sublime. Just the right mix of sweet and heat. The mombo mint though was a little too thick in consistency.'), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED

  Amazing and sumptuous ambience with a decent and sofisticated crowd if I may say. If you are someone who has this impression that South Indian food only means Idli and Dosa.. you will be amazed by the wide varieties of dishes and desserts they have got. This place is a bit on the expensive side but definitely worth a try.'), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED
  Visited this place on a Friday night. We actually went to windmills and because of their bad service we decided to head to oota!
The place looks so glamorous. Very well set up, extremely nice staff, well trained, service is a bit on the slower side but I guess that is because they make everything fresh.

We ordered chicken sukka, kozhi curry, neer dosa, akki roti and jowar roti. The chicken sukka was brilliant, very nicely spiced and the right amout of citrusy notes. Even the kozhi curry was good. The rotis and the neer dosas were exceptional! I somehow felt that the texture of the chicken was a little off. Maybe because it was in cold storage for a while and it wasn't fresh. That's my only complain here.

Even the papads they served were note worthy, my favourite was the onion papad. All the chutneys were yummy!

Is the food worth the price? I don't think so.
Is the experience worth the price? Maybe!"), ('Rated 4.0', 'RATED

[('Rated 1.0', 'RATED
  The chicken was rubbery and dry. The quantity is less for what I paid as well. Really overrated biryani. Would not recommend to anyone. No comparison to Meghanas, nagarjuna, bheema, etc.'), ('Rated 1.0', 'RATED
  Ordered chicken biryani from here.

Came with a curry and raita.
It was bland, not at all flavourful and just not close to my expectations after reading a few reviews mentioned here.

Never ordering again!'), ('Rated 5.0', "RATED
  I felt it's an underrated place to try amazing Mutton biryani. The biryani was flavourful and aromatic and prepared with long grain Basmati rice. Overall, it's a nice place and I recommend it."), ('Rated 4.0', "RATED
